finding.rationale: Kiota 1.35.0 bundles affected MessagePack. The pinned generation path invokes only kiota generate; no route to untrusted MessagePack object deserialization was identified. This is a time-limited reachability assessment, not proof that the library is safe.
finding.compensatingControl: Verify exact Kiota package SHA-256 5e75f6adf161717be8d9f39eb596f93d52535e7b8cbcc00cffdcef3d0d3c3486; fixed generate arguments; immutable image and source-bound scan; network-disabled, read-only, non-root container; 2 GiB memory and 120-second limits. Reassess on upstream fix or invocation change.
